newsitem.title: JAPAN: June JGB futures end down ahead of benchmark shift.
newsitem.headline: June JGB futures end down ahead of benchmark shift.

text.p: *Key June 10-year JGB futures ended lower, as some players rolled over their long positions from June to September contract ahead of benchmark shift.
*Dealers were predominant in market, as investors remained cautious ahead of release of BOJ's "tankan" survey on June 25.
